chain.title: Dust of the Dragon
chain.desc: Draconium Ore spawns deep in the overworld, in the Nether, and richest of all in the End; each ore drops 2-4 dust. Everything this mod does starts as this purple powder.

chain.title: Smelt Draconium
chain.desc: Smelt the dust into ingots and keep the furnace running - the entire ladder from here to the Chaotic tier is paved with these.

chain.title: The Draconium Core
chain.desc: Draconium, gold and a diamond make the component that sits in nearly every DE recipe - machines, injectors, tools. You will craft dozens of these before you are done.

chain.title: Stopgap Power
chain.desc: Everything from here on runs on Forge Energy, including fusion crafting itself. This little generator burns anything a furnace burns and holds you over until the Draconic Reactor.

chain.title: Fusion Crafting Core
chain.desc: The centerpiece of DE's multiblock crafting system. Place it with open air around it - injectors around the room do the actual work while this holds the catalyst.

chain.title: Ring of Injectors
chain.desc: Craft several, aim them at the Fusion Crafting Core and feed them power. This Draconium-tier ring crafts everything up to Wyvern gear - your first fusion recipes are now open.

chain.title: Wyvern Energy Core
chain.desc: A draconium core wrapped in redstone blocks. This is the power-storage component inside every Wyvern tool, relay crystal and the Energy Core multiblock - stock up.

chain.title: A Star in a Core
chain.desc: Four draconium cores around a Nether Star. Killing the Wither is the real cost here; the Wyvern Core gates every mid-tier machine and upgrade in the mod.

chain.title: Wyvern Tier Injectors
chain.desc: Fuse a Wyvern Core onto each basic injector to upgrade your ring. Wyvern-tier fusion is required for the tools, armor and the awakening recipe coming next.

chain.title: Wyvern Tools
chain.desc: Fusion-craft over a plain diamond pickaxe. Wyvern tools run on RF instead of durability and accept modules - AOE mining, speed, auto-smelt-style upgrades - in their module grid.

chain.title: Shielded
chain.desc: The Wyvern Chestpiece replaces armor points with a rechargeable energy shield. As long as it has power and shield capacity modules, you effectively do not take damage.

chain.title: Modular Everything
chain.desc: Every upgrade in DE - speed, AOE, shields, night vision, flight - is a module built on this cheap core and socketed into your gear's module grid. Craft a pile of them.

chain.title: Crystal Network
chain.desc: Relay crystals beam energy between machines with no cables. Link them with the Crystal Binder; I/O crystals attach to blocks, wireless crystals charge things at range.

chain.title: The Energy Sphere
chain.desc: The famous floating energy ball. Built with draconium blocks and stabilizers in 8 tiers - tier 1 fits on a table, tier 8 stores functionally infinite power for the reactor era.

chain.title: Tap the Core
chain.desc: Pylons are the only way power gets in or out of the Energy Core multiblock. Place at least two - one set to input, one to output - within range of the sphere.

chain.title: Heart of the Dragon
chain.desc: The Ender Dragon drops its heart when slain. This is the catalyst that awakens draconium - every kill is four more Awakened Draconium Blocks, so keep respawning her.

chain.title: The Awakening
chain.desc: Wyvern-tier fusion: six draconium cores and a Dragon Heart over four draconium blocks transmutes them into four Awakened Draconium Blocks - the orange metal of the Draconic tier.

chain.title: Awakened Ingots
chain.desc: Break the awakened blocks down into ingots. Draconic-tier tools, cores, injectors and reactor parts all eat these by the stack.

chain.title: Core of the Awakened
chain.desc: Fuse Wyvern Cores and awakened ingots around another Nether Star. In-game it is called the Draconic Core - the gate component for everything at Draconic tier.

chain.title: Draconic Tier Injectors
chain.desc: Upgrade the injector ring again with awakened draconium. Draconic-tier fusion unlocks the top-end tools, armor and the Chaotic injectors beyond them.

chain.title: Draconic Energy Core
chain.desc: The awakened version of the Wyvern Energy Core. You need these for every Draconic tool and armor piece, plus the Reactor Stabilizers later - do not craft just one.

chain.title: Draconic Tools
chain.desc: Your Wyvern pickaxe is the catalyst - fuse it upward with netherite and awakened draconium. Draconic tools take the bigger AOE and speed modules and never need replacing.

chain.title: Wings Without Wings
chain.desc: The Draconic Chestpiece accepts a Flight Module for true creative-style flight, plus a bigger shield. You will want it before picking a fight with what lives on the chaos islands.

chain.title: The Chaos Guardian
chain.desc: Chaos Islands generate far out in the End, each guarded by a corrupted dragon that hits through armor. Kill it and destroy its crystals to claim the island's Chaos Crystal.

chain.title: Chaos, Compressed
chain.desc: Harvesting the Chaos Crystal yields fragments - compress tiny into small, small into large, and nine large into a full Chaos Shard, the fuel and catalyst of the endgame.

chain.title: Chaotic Core
chain.desc: Draconic-tier fusion of Draconic Cores, awakened ingots and Large Chaos Fragments. The final core component - reactors, Chaotic gear and the last injector tier all want it.

chain.title: Chaotic Tier Injectors
chain.desc: The last injector upgrade costs chaos fragments and a Dragon Egg per injector. With a Chaotic-tier ring, no recipe in the mod is out of reach.

chain.title: Draconic Reactor
chain.desc: A reactor fueled by awakened draconium and kickstarted with a Chaos Shard. It outputs millions of RF/t - and detonates like nothing else in the game if you let containment fail.

chain.title: Contain the Burn
chain.desc: Four stabilizers frame the core and an Energy Injector charges it. The one hard rule: containment draws power constantly, so give the injector its own dedicated line and never let the shield reach zero - an uncontained reactor does not shut down, it detonates.

chain.title: Staff of Power
chain.desc: Fuse your Chaotic pickaxe, shovel and sword into one weapon - the Chaotic Staff of Power mines, digs and kills better than all three. This is the mod's final crafting recipe.

notes: Verified against jar in the GayChaseyPacxk instance (a 3.1.2.604 copy also exists in 'cobblemon pack for colty test'; 1.10.2 copies in SkyFactory 3 instances ignored). Tier ladder confirmed from recipe 'tier' fields: basic injector (crafting table) -> wyvern injector (DRACONIUM-tier fusion) -> awakened injector (WYVERN-tier) -> chaotic injector (DRACONIC-tier, costs a dragon egg each). In 3.x, awakening draconium is a WYVERN-tier fusion recipe (dragon heart + 6 draconium cores over 4 draconium blocks -> 4 awakened blocks), not the old ritual. Dragon Heart is a code drop from the Ender Dragon (no loot table in jar). Chaos islands and end comets are worldgen configured_features; the boss entity id is draconicevolution:draconic_guardian (display name 'Chaos Guardian'). Ore drops 2-4 draconium_dust (fortune-able); ingots smelt from dust. Naming trap: item id awakened_core displays as 'Draconic Core', and small/medium/large_chaos_frag display as Tiny/Small/Large Chaos Fragment. Energy Core multiblock tiers 1-8 defined in data/draconicevolution/multiblocks/. Draconic-Additions is a separate mod (present in same instance, not covered here). stabilized_spawner and mob_soul excluded: no recipes in jar (obtained via mob grinder soul drops / in-world mechanics). item_count_in_jar = 182 item/block lang entries.
